extracted.intended_audience: registered patent practitioners and their counsel (those seeking reinstatement before the USPTO) and USPTO enrollment/discipline staff
extracted.subtask_description: Petitioning for reinstatement to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office under the Office of Enrollment and Discipline procedures (37 C.F.R. § 11.58), including filing a supporting affidavit and review of the administrative record by the Acting Director.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition for Reinstatement (submission/receipt)
rubrics_metrics.description: Consideration has been given to the Petition for Reinstatement of Zachary R. Hiller (Registration Number 69,155) received on November 17, 2023.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A formal petition must be filed and received by the Office; the petition itself is a primary document the Office considers when evaluating eligibility for reinstatement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: Mr. Hiller, through counsel, has filed an Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 in support of the Petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An affidavit filed under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 is submitted in support of a reinstatement petition and is a regulatory component the Office expects to accompany the petition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review of petition, supporting affidavit, and all record information material to eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: After careful review of the Petition, the supporting affidavit, and all information in the record material to his eligibility for reinstatement, the Acting Director ... has determined that reinstatement ... is appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The adjudicative review considers the petition, the § 11.58 affidavit, and any other record materials bearing on eligibility; the decision hinges on the totality of those materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acting Director authority to determine and grant reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: The Acting Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline has determined that reinstatement ... is appropriate. Accordingly, the Petition is hereby GRANTED.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Acting Director (Acting Deputy General Counsel for Enrollment and Discipline) is the decision-maker who may grant reinstatement after review; the grant is the formal remedy reflected in the decision document.
